tasks.short: Guide students preparing for an equivalency examination

steps.what: Provide examination information, guidance and preparation tailored to the student

tasks.design: The instructor explains current examination requirements and guides preparation using official information in {DOCS}. The design retains individual explanation, practice and feedback.
tasks.previous_blocker: Students need help interpreting requirements and addressing their own gaps.
tasks.enabler_now: Official resources support guidance without replacing the interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing unfamiliarity with the examination from underlying learning needs.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor recognises confusion and adapts preparation.
tasks.altitude: Examination guidance responsibility and contact time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate practice around identified examination needs
reach.learn: Current examination structure and adult learning barriers

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: examination guidance and preparation remain human; no clerical information-search baseline is specified.

assumptions: Boundary is examination information and guided preparation, excluding registration and original resource authoring. The US credential in the task is used only where actually offered; a European provider must confirm its relevant credential.
The official examination owner supplies current requirements and the instructor assesses student needs during s1. No free structured examination-readiness score is assumed.
Use existing official information first; native runtime earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no new guidance tool is introduced.
unknowns: Credential offered and current official requirements
research_questions: Which preparation questions require individual explanation despite complete official information?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Individual guidance and preparation retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and schedule accessible class times

steps.what: Gather class attendance constraints and available teaching slots
Compare candidate class times against the captured attendance constraints
Select and schedule class times after checking attendance and access trade-offs

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} and {CALENDAR} comparisons to show which candidate times fit the instructor's captured availability information. The instructor checks gaps and access implications, then chooses and communicates the timetable; the comparison does not guarantee maximum attendance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Candidate times can require repeated manual availability comparisons.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed overlap counts can repeat explicit constraints without predicting personal behaviour.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain availability and barriers not visible in past attendance.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor weighs access and discusses conflicts with students.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated comparison while timetable decisions remain human.

reach.task: Coordinate room and teaching availability across classes
reach.learn: Scheduling constraints and learner access needs

evidence.claim: Momoyoga supports class schedules and bookings; this establishes adjacent scheduling capability, not prediction or maximisation of adult student attendance.
Model knowledge: native overlap comparisons may reduce manual scheduling work; the proposed saving is unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is class-time selection and scheduling, excluding actual attendance, room operation and teaching delivery.

Existing students and scheduling owners provide availability through the current discussion process. In s1 the instructor captures class/cohort IDs, candidate dates, duration, timezone, student availability windows and unknowns, teacher windows, room commitments and source dates; the full 40% includes first capture and clarification.
Missing or uncertain availability remains a gap for s3 discussion rather than a predicted availability flag. No additional student survey or self-service data-entry burden is introduced.

Test native scheduling first; existing automatic comparison earns no new saving. Six extra focal hours count constraint changes and additional rescheduling, and 3 other-role hours count scheduling administrator resource-map upkeep.
unknowns: Existing scheduling tools and actual comparison time
Completeness and currency of availability information
research_questions: Does overlap comparison save time after availability capture and access-conflict discussion?

already_counted.description: Availability discussion and structured first capture
Access trade-offs, timetable choice and release

approvals.approved_version: Exact timetable, cohort, availability snapshot, rooms, teacher commitments and student recipients checked in s3; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+35=75; gross 25%, net 19% after 6 focal upkeep. Range covers existing automatic scheduling with zero gain through 14 points of manual comparison removed minus 6 upkeep. Capture and timetable judgement remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train tutors and community literacy volunteers

steps.what: Train and assist tutors and community literacy volunteers through practice and feedback

tasks.design: The instructor demonstrates methods and assists tutors using approved literacy material in {DOCS}. Responsive coaching and observation remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tutors need help applying methods to actual learner difficulties.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing resources support coaching without replacing it.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising misunderstanding and choosing feedback that changes practice.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor responds to how the tutor actually teaches.
tasks.altitude: Tutor-development responsibility and contact time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate literacy support for a learner needing extra practice

evidence.claim: Tutor CoPilot's trial found improved learner topic mastery with human tutors; it does not establish a reduction in the instructor's volunteer-training time.

assumptions: Boundary is tutor training and assistance, excluding material authoring and the tutors' own teaching labour.
The instructor identifies needs and selects resources during s1. Tutors produce questions and practice after instruction during s1 before feedback; no structured tutor-competence flag is assumed.
Use native resources first; existing runtime earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no new tutor assistant or training process is introduced.
research_questions: Which tutor difficulties require observing practice rather than providing a written answer?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net 0%. Live tutor development retains all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Observe the teaching performance of other instructors
Evaluate instructor performance and discuss evidence-based feedback

tasks.design: The instructor observes teaching directly and discusses the evaluation using agreed criteria in {DOCS}. No automated worker score or generated performance verdict is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance evidence needs context and a fair opportunity for explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing criteria support consistency without replacing observation or judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a single difficult session from a persistent development need.
tasks.human_edge: The observer recognises context and gives constructive, accountable feedback.

reach.task: Coordinate fair teaching observation and feedback

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: teaching observation and performance evaluation remain human; no removable report-writing baseline is specified.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and evaluation, excluding subsequent training and formal employment decisions by other authorities.

The responsible coordinator supplies criteria and the observer gathers evidence in s1 before evaluation in s2. The observed instructor supplies context during s2; no free structured performance score is assumed.
Use native criteria documents first; existing runtime earns no saving. Zero incremental upkeep because no staff-monitoring application is introduced.
unknowns: Observation purpose, criteria and evaluation authority
research_questions: Which evaluation conclusions need contextual discussion beyond observed behaviour?

approvals.approved_version: Exact instructor evaluation, observation evidence, criteria version and development feedback checked in s2; changes void approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70+30=100; net 0%. Observation and performance judgement retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Native class-time comparisons can reduce repeated scheduling arithmetic while guidance, coaching and peer evaluation stay human.
reach: Coordinate availability and learning support with tutors and instructional staff.
role.ambitious_version: Better supported teaching with clear scheduling constraints and no unsupported reduction in learner or staff contact.

job.title: Adult Basic Education, Adult Secondary Education, and English as a Second Language Instructors
